sources.title: Q-Router: Agentic Video Quality Assessment with Expert Model Routing
sources.snippet: We propose Q-Router, an agentic framework for universal VQA with a multi-tier model routing system. Q-Router integrates a diverse set of expert models and employs vision-language models (VLMs) as real-time routers that dynamically reason then ensemble the most appropriate experts conditioned on the input video semantics.
